title: Article "They're baaaack (again) Unidentified lights reappear in Erth" (Oct 2009)
description: Reproduced Stephenville Empire-Tribune article dated Tuesday, October 20, 2009, headlined "They're baaaack (again) Unidentified lights reappear in Erth," with highlighted passages. It reports residents of Erath County seeing amber glowing lights that appeared, disappeared and reappeared at varying heights, and a grainy cell phone recording of an amber light. The report introduces it under "EVIDENCE:" noting the article seems to describe the same type of lights activity seen a month later.
